pageCache.pageTitle: Welcome from the Interim Headteacher - Joydens Wood Infant & Junior Schools
pageCache.text:
Welcome from the Interim Headteacher
Welcome to the Joydens Wood Infants and Junior Schools' website. We are delighted to have you here and hope that you find the information both informative and engaging.
At Joydens Wood, we pride ourselves on being two separate yet closely-knit schools, dedicated to providing a seamless and enriching educational journey for our children from Reception through to the end of Year 6. Our collaborative approach ensures that all learners receive a consistent and cohesive primary education, which is essential for their development in these formative years.
Our schools foster a warm, inviting environment—one that is characterised by happiness and friendliness. We understand that education extends beyond the confines of the classroom; thus, we work in partnership with families and our local community to nurture the whole child, addressing their emotional, social, and academic needs. Our commitment to developing well-rounded individuals is central to our ethos and is reflected in the daily experiences offered to students.
We offer a broad and balanced curriculum designed to inspire a love of learning and cater to the diverse interests of our pupils. This curriculum is enriched by a wide range of extra-curricular clubs and activities, providing students with the opportunity to take an active role in school life and explore their passions further. Whether it be through sports, music, drama, or other pursuits, we believe that such involvement not only enhances academic achievement but also cultivates essential life skills such as teamwork, resilience, and leadership.
The achievements of our pupils fill us with immense pride. From academic accolades to artistic accomplishments, every milestone is a testament to their hard work and determination. Our dedicated staff are committed to fostering an environment where children can thrive, encouraging them to aim high and believe in their potential.
Each child is an individual, and we celebrate their unique strengths and talents, guiding them in their learning journey and preparing them for the next stage of their education.
As you navigate through our website, you will discover a wealth of information about our schools, our values, and the opportunities available to our students. We invite you to explore our curriculum offerings, extra-curricular activities, and the various ways in which we engage with our school community. We hope that you will gain insight into what makes Joydens Wood a vibrant place for learning and growth.
If you have any questions or require further information, please do not hesitate to get in touch. We look forward to working together to support your child's education and future success.
Thank you once again for visiting our website. We hope you enjoy your experience and find it a useful reference tool, providing you with a flavour of what life is like at Joydens Wood Infants and Junior Schools.
Mr Paul Redford
Interim Headteacher

pageCache.pageTitle: Prospective/New Parents - Joydens Wood Infant & Junior Schools
pageCache.text:
Prospective/New Parents
Thank you for your interest in the Joydens Wood Schools.
If you would like to find out more about life at Joydens Wood please take a look around our website for more information. If you have any unanswered questions, please don't hesitate to contact the school office.
For prospective parents and carers for entry into the Junior School, please contact the school office who can advise on the next opportunity to visit the school.
Key Dates for EYFS Transition
Stay and Play - Wednesday 24th June 2026 - 3:45-4:45pm (parents and children)
Transition Session & Parents Networking Event - Tuesday 7th July 2026 - 1:30-2:30pm (parents in school hall)
Transition Session - Wednesday 8th July 2026 - 1:30-2:30pm (parents drop off their children)
What is learning like at Joydens Wood?
Starting Reception
Starting school is an exciting milestone for children and families. To support a smooth and positive transition into Reception, please encourage parents and carers to access the Starting Reception resources:
Starting Reception is a free, practical online resource designed to help families prepare their child for school through simple activities, helpful advice and clear guidance on key skills and routines that support confidence and readiness.
Additional resources include:
Best Start in Life – Preparing for School Campaign
As part of the Government’s Early Years Strategy, the Best Start in Life campaign brings together trusted advice to help families understand how everyday moments support children’s development.
This week saw the launch of Preparing for School, which supports parents and guardians of children starting school this September and highlights that readiness is about everyday skills, not just uniform.
At the heart of the campaign is the Steps for School song – a new music video featuring a rap by award-winning teacher-turned-rapper MC Grammar. The video highlights simple, practical steps parents can practice with their child to support their development and build confidence and independence.
Key resources include:
What will school look like for my child in Reception?
What can I expect from the first week of school for my child?

pageCache.pageTitle: Wrap Around Care - Joydens Wood Infant & Junior Schools
pageCache.text:
Wrap Around Care
Joydens Wood Breakfast and After School Club Ltd
Please Note: This is not run by Joydens Wood Junior School. It is an external business providing wrap around care for the children at our school.
Fun activities to keep your child safe and happy in a warm, friendly and caring environment
Please click here to see their details with Companies House
BREAKFAST CLUB - Reception - Year 6 7.00 - 9.00am This is a safe, fun and friendly environment where your child can enjoy a selection of breakfast options before they are taken to school to start their day. 7.00 - 8.45am: £10.50 8.00 - 8.45am: £5.50 AFTER SCHOOL CLUB - Reception - Year 6 3.15 - 6.30pm The children will be collected at the end of the school day and will participate in a wide range of child lead activities. They will be provided with fruit, drinks and a tea time meal. 3.10pm Infants/3.15pm Juniors - 6.30pm: £16
Your child can extend their school by enjoying activities of their choice, within our school grounds. Our experienced staff are qualified in Early Years, Playwork, First Aid, Child Protection and Food Hygiene. Please call Lisa Lewer or Lorraine Ayres on 07826 040192.
